craft_notes: Sthāyin: penetration-end (dhāraṇā #67 — power-penetration's end returns from v69: the refrain of arrival). Sanskrit: āśrayād vā śaktir jñānavā vā cittalayād vā śaktipātāntaḥ...bhairavākāraḥ → L4 keeps the three-or chain whole line 1. Rows: row 3 (end→form). Close: form (the name arrives as FORM: bhairavākāra — the refrain of form-won with v84/88). Rejected: 'shaktipat' jargon — killed: power-penetration kept; splitting the or-chain — killed: all three doors named equally.

lines: Supports or power, knowing, or mind-dissolving:
l4.sanskrit_cite: ādhāreṣv athavā 'śaktyā 'jñānāc cittalayena vā | jātaśaktisamāveśakṣobhānte bhairavaṃ vapuḥ

reads_against.argmap: What power brings the form? → Whichever of the three means ends in agitation-calm — Bhairava form is born.
c1_essence: Whatever means — power, knowing, mind-dissolve: Bhairava-form.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness reached through force of attention)
